title: Jezero requested landmark register
status: evidence-triage; unresolved coordinates are intentionally null

layerNotes.geological_features: Use companion SIM 3464 polygon/line layers; source map coverage does not span the full DEM.
layerNotes.rover_exploration: Use PLACES observations/traverse separately; rover stops do not equal named-feature coordinates.
layerNotes.scientific_interest: No invented score; scientific significance is descriptive and separate from route safety.
layerNotes.terrain_hazards: No named hazards asserted. Derive slope/roughness hazards from validated DEM at runtime or offline preprocessing; not included in this named register.
layerNotes.points_of_interest: Informal names need authoritative waypoint geometries before coordinate placement.

properties.name: Jezero Crater rim
properties.geologicalDescription: Impact crater rim; use USGS crater-rim crest lines and rim-unit polygons, not a point.
properties.scientificSignificance: Defines basin boundary and relief; rim breaching records past hydrology.
properties.coordinateSource: Actual USGS SIM 3464 mapped geometry, transformed to Mars east longitude / planetocentric latitude and clipped to DEM footprint; see source feature properties for map coverage caveat. No point coordinate substituted.
properties.geometryNote: GeometryCollection of individually valid USGS SIM 3464 mapped components; source geometries are clipped to DEM bounds and the geologic map's own smaller coverage. Rim includes mapped rim-unit polygons and interpreted rim-crest line segments. Not a complete feature footprint outside mapped coverage.

properties.name: Western Delta
properties.geologicalDescription: Western fluvio-deltaic fan deposits at the mouth of Neretva Vallis.
properties.scientificSignificance: Preserves fluvial and lacustrine deposits and potential biosignature-bearing sediments.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance explored the western fan and sampled its sedimentary succession.
properties.coordinateSource: Actual USGS SIM 3464 mapped geometry, transformed to Mars east longitude / planetocentric latitude and clipped to DEM footprint; see source feature properties for map coverage caveat. No point coordinate substituted.
properties.geometryNote: GeometryCollection of individually valid USGS SIM 3464 mapped components; source geometries are clipped to DEM bounds and the geologic map's own smaller coverage. Rim includes mapped rim-unit polygons and interpreted rim-crest line segments. Not a complete feature footprint outside mapped coverage.

properties.name: Northern Delta
properties.geologicalDescription: Eroded fan deposits in the northern crater; literature notes their origin and relation to the western delta remain debated.
properties.scientificSignificance: Constrains northern-inlet sediment transport and basin history.
properties.coordinateSource: Use mapped deposits and preserve interpretation caveat; no point coordinate assigned.

properties.name: Neretva Vallis
properties.geometryType: LineString region; point is official center
properties.geologicalDescription: Inlet valley/channel entering Jezero from the west/northwest.
properties.scientificSignificance: Records fluvial transport into the paleolake; rover observations include fluvio-lacustrine strata.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance investigated the inlet channel including Tuff Cliff / Bright Angel region.
properties.coordinateSource: Representative point is the Gazetteer center (77.20°E, 18.55°N); source extent 77.00–77.30°E, 18.50–18.60°N. Full feature remains linear.
properties.geometryNote: Geometry is the official gazetteer center point for catalog display; the named landform is linear and its source extent is recorded separately.

properties.name: Sava Vallis
properties.geometryType: LineString region; point is official center
properties.geologicalDescription: Named western/northern inlet valley system in regional nomenclature.
properties.scientificSignificance: Evidence for fluvial inflow to Jezero basin.
properties.coordinateSource: Representative point is the Gazetteer center (77.13°E, 19.09°N); source extent 76.69–77.56°E, 18.74–19.43°N, so the valley crosses the DEM boundary.
properties.geometryNote: Geometry is the official gazetteer center point for catalog display; the named landform is linear and its source extent is recorded separately.

properties.name: Eastern Outlet Valley (Pliva Vallis)
properties.geometryType: LineString region; point is official center
properties.geologicalDescription: The eastern outlet channel is officially named Pliva Vallis; “Eastern Outlet Valley” is a descriptive synonym, not a separate feature.
properties.scientificSignificance: Records overflow/drainage and episodic fluvial activity.
properties.coordinateSource: Representative point is the Gazetteer center (78.35°E, 18.67°N); source extent 78.09–78.60°E, 18.52–18.81°N, extending slightly beyond the DEM east edge.
properties.geometryNote: Geometry is the official gazetteer center point for catalog display; the named landform is linear and its source extent is recorded separately.

properties.name: Ancient lake basin
properties.geologicalDescription: Jezero hosted an ancient lake; reconstructed lake extents vary with inferred water level and time.
properties.scientificSignificance: Habitability context and depositional setting for delta/lacustrine sediments.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Mission investigates rocks formed in and around the paleolake.
properties.coordinateSource: Represent individual published paleolake-level contours as separate dated/inferred lines; no single exact polygon asserted.

properties.name: Crater rim breach
properties.geologicalDescription: Eroded eastern rim breach/outlet associated with discharge through Pliva Vallis.
properties.scientificSignificance: Constrains open-basin phase and outflow-flood history.
properties.sourceName: Fassett et al. outlet-forming flood study
properties.coordinateSource: Requires DEM-derived/local mapped breach outline; not a point.

properties.name: Kodiak Butte (Kodiak)
properties.geometryType: Point plus mapped polygon if sourced
properties.geologicalDescription: Eroded isolated western fan remnant with preserved bottomset, foreset, and topset strata.
properties.scientificSignificance: Key evidence for Jezero delta deposition and changing lake level.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Imaged by Perseverance from the landing region; not a rover stop named as the feature center.
properties.coordinateSource: Published orbital/rover mapping identifies it; this repo has no verified footprint/center coordinate. No screenshot estimate.

properties.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing Site
properties.geologicalDescription: Perseverance touchdown location.
properties.scientificSignificance: Mission entry point for in-situ exploration.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Touchdown on Sol 0, 18 February 2021.
properties.coordinateSource: Published landing coordinate 77.4509°E, 18.4446°N; planetocentric, east-positive.

properties.name: Séítah
properties.geologicalDescription: Informal name for olivine-rich crater-floor unit and rover exploration area; consists of dispersed exposures among aeolian bedforms.
properties.scientificSignificance: Records ancient igneous/crater-floor geology, with possible aqueous alteration.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Explored during first science campaign; rover traversed exposures and collected samples.
properties.coordinateSource: Use mapped unit/exposure geometry; avoid a single point for broad unit.

properties.name: Máaz Formation
properties.geologicalDescription: Informal name for basaltic crater-floor rocks overlying Séítah.
properties.scientificSignificance: Constrains igneous history and the stratigraphy of Jezero floor.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Studied and sampled during first science campaign.
properties.coordinateSource: Use published unit map/USGS correlations, not point coordinate.

properties.name: Three Forks
properties.geologicalDescription: Named location of Perseverance's sample depot. Depot event table identifies ten drops but does not provide individual tube coordinates.
properties.scientificSignificance: Preserves cached samples for possible future return.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Ten sample tubes deposited during December 2022–January 2023; individual positions must not be inferred from rover position.
properties.sourceName: NASA annotated panorama; PDS Three Forks depot bundle
properties.coordinateSource: Exact depot coordinate / individual tube locations not joined in repository.

properties.name: Hawksbill Gap
properties.geologicalDescription: Named passage/outcrop area in the western delta front, associated with the Shenandoah formation.
properties.scientificSignificance: Exposes delta-front sedimentary stratigraphy.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance traversed and sampled in the delta-front campaign.
properties.sourceName: NASA annotated panorama; AGU stratigraphy paper
properties.coordinateSource: Use rover observation localizations or source map GIS; no point inferred from illustration.

properties.name: Kodiak
properties.geologicalDescription: Same geological landmark as Kodiak Butte; not a second feature.
properties.scientificSignificance: Delta stratigraphy and paleolake-level evidence.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance observed remotely; distinguish rover observation positions from butte location.
properties.coordinateSource: Alias of Kodiak Butte; deduplicate geometry.

properties.name: Belva Crater
properties.geologicalDescription: Named impact crater and nearby rover observation area. Existing “Belva” coordinate is a USGS text-label anchor, not necessarily crater center.
properties.scientificSignificance: Provides exposure/context for crater-floor stratigraphy.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Visited/imaged by Perseverance during delta approach.
properties.coordinateSource: Existing anchor in jezero_landmarks.geojson must not be promoted to crater center.

properties.name: Enchanted Lake
properties.geologicalDescription: Informal named sedimentary outcrop/area at the base of the western fan; the full outcrop boundary is not represented.
properties.scientificSignificance: Layered sedimentary rocks preserve facies consistent with subaqueous deposition.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance worked in the Enchanted Lake area during sols 420–426; this is its archived Sol 426 rover localization, a visit point rather than the outcrop center.
properties.coordinateSource: PDS PLACES Release 16 last archived ROVER localization for Sol 426, Site 24, Drive 902 (https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/m2020/urn-nasa-pds-mars2020_rover_places/data_localizations/best_interp.csv); associated with the named area by the mission/science source. This is a visit locality, not a feature center or boundary. Positional accuracy is not specified in best_interp.csv.
properties.geometryNote: Point is the last PDS PLACES rover localization on the referenced visit sol, associated with the named locality by the cited mission/science source. It is not the center, boundary, or exact science-target coordinate.

properties.name: Cape Nukshak
properties.geologicalDescription: Named section/outcrop along eastern scarp of the western delta, in the Shenandoah formation.
properties.scientificSignificance: Exposes lower delta sequence and facies architecture.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance investigated the section during delta-front campaign.
properties.sourceName: NASA NTRS lower delta sequence study
properties.coordinateSource: Source confirms location context; exact geometry needs mission waypoint join.

properties.name: Artuby Ridge
properties.geologicalDescription: Informal ridge/region south of landing area, associated with Máaz/Séítah exposures.
properties.scientificSignificance: Stratigraphic relationships and crater-floor geology.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance traversed and investigated Artuby Ridge; flight reconnaissance supported planning.
properties.coordinateSource: Use source map / PLACES localized stops to trace rover traverse; no representative point inferred.

properties.name: Tuff Cliff
properties.geologicalDescription: Outcrop/member in Neretva Vallis inlet channel, stratigraphically associated with fluvio-lacustrine deposits.
properties.scientificSignificance: Records transition toward sustained lacustrine conditions.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Observed by Perseverance in the Bright Angel exploration region.
properties.coordinateSource: Precise feature geometry not bundled; NASA panorama says outcrop is ~480 m east of Cheyava Falls but that is not a coordinate.

properties.name: Valinor Hills
properties.geologicalDescription: Informal named feature appearing on NASA Mars 2020 traverse map materials.
properties.scientificSignificance: No independent scientific interpretation assigned from available source.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Mission traverse-map label; exact footprint not joined.
properties.coordinateSource: NASA figure label is not coordinate geometry.

properties.name: Beehive Geyser
properties.geologicalDescription: Informal area about 500 m west of the rover at Sol 1059; name does not establish a geological geyser process.
properties.scientificSignificance: NASA describes a margin-unit interval about 60 m above an earlier sampled section; scientific interest is stratigraphic comparison.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance planned an excursion there in February 2024.
properties.coordinateSource: Relative distance/direction only; do not turn into a coordinate.

properties.name: Bunsen Peak
properties.geologicalDescription: Large rock on a ridge in the Margin unit; sample source for Comet Geyser.
properties.scientificSignificance: Sampled sedimentary rock helps characterize the carbonate-bearing Margin unit.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance performed proximity science and collected its 27th named sample at the Bunsen Peak target on Sol 1088.
properties.sourceName: NASA Science and NASA sample inventory
properties.coordinateSource: Named target confirmed; exact location can be joined from rover localization and sample event metadata.

properties.name: Jurabi Point
properties.geologicalDescription: Named waypoint in the Margin Unit campaign.
properties.scientificSignificance: Provides context for the rover's exploration of carbonate-bearing margin terrain.
properties.perseveranceHistory: NASA reports Perseverance arrived at Jurabi Point on Sol 958; this is the archived last rover localization for that sol, not a surveyed landmark boundary.
properties.sourceName: NASA Science, Here Comes the Sun; PDS PLACES
properties.coordinateSource: PDS PLACES Release 16 last archived ROVER localization for Sol 958, Site 46, Drive 3888 (https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/m2020/urn-nasa-pds-mars2020_rover_places/data_localizations/best_interp.csv); associated with the named area by the mission/science source. This is a visit locality, not a feature center or boundary. Positional accuracy is not specified in best_interp.csv.
properties.geometryNote: Point is the last PDS PLACES rover localization on the referenced visit sol, associated with the named locality by the cited mission/science source. It is not the center, boundary, or exact science-target coordinate.

properties.name: Gnaraloo Bay
properties.geologicalDescription: Erosional window through the western fan apex exposing underlying Margin Unit; the full region boundary is not represented.
properties.scientificSignificance: Exposes the fan-Margin unconformity and stratigraphic relations.
properties.perseveranceHistory: NASA reports Perseverance drove into Gnaraloo Bay on Sol 959; this is the archived Sol 959 rover localization, a visit point rather than the region center.
properties.coordinateSource: PDS PLACES Release 16 last archived ROVER localization for Sol 959, Site 46, Drive 5542 (https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/m2020/urn-nasa-pds-mars2020_rover_places/data_localizations/best_interp.csv); associated with the named area by the mission/science source. This is a visit locality, not a feature center or boundary. Positional accuracy is not specified in best_interp.csv.
properties.geometryNote: Point is the last PDS PLACES rover localization on the referenced visit sol, associated with the named locality by the cited mission/science source. It is not the center, boundary, or exact science-target coordinate.

properties.name: Mandu Wall
properties.geologicalDescription: Named Margin Unit terrain region associated with the first sample, Pelican Point.
properties.scientificSignificance: Context for carbonate-bearing rocks and possible shoreline/volcanic/alteration interpretations.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Explored during the Margin campaign; Pelican Point collected from workspace within Mandu Wall.
properties.coordinateSource: Use traverse/sample observations and regional mapping; no representative point asserted.

properties.name: Pelican Point
properties.geologicalDescription: Perseverance sample name collected at Hans Amundsen Memorial Workspace within Mandu Wall.
properties.scientificSignificance: First sample from the carbonate-rich Margin Unit; helps assess its origin and habitability context.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Core/sample 22 collected on Sol 923.
properties.coordinateSource: Sample/workspace coordinates should be joined from PDS PLACES or sample localization metadata.

properties.name: Pinestand
properties.geologicalDescription: Requested name not verified in available bundled authoritative sources; do not assume it is a distinct Jezero landmark.
properties.scientificSignificance: Unassigned pending verification.
properties.perseveranceHistory: No verified exploration record in sources reviewed.
properties.coordinateSource: Name and coordinate need primary source confirmation.

properties.name: Faraway Rock
properties.geologicalDescription: Named group of rocks near the inner crater rim, encountered at the start of the crater-rim campaign.
properties.scientificSignificance: Rim campaign explores older crustal materials and stratigraphy.
properties.perseveranceHistory: Perseverance reached the area around Sol 1282 and began the rim ascent campaign.
properties.coordinateSource: Named regional location confirmed; rover stop/localization join required for coordinate.
